title: eGFR by CKD-EPI Creatinine Equation (eGFRcr) (2021) in Adults

content.equation:
Glomerular Filtration Rate Estimation by Race-Free CKD-EPI Equation in Adults Using Creatinine (eGFRcr) (2021) (Conventional and SI Units)
eGFRcr = 142 * min(Serum creatinine/kappa, 1)alpha * max(Serum creatinine/kappa, 1)-1.2 * 0.9938Age * SexFactor
BSA = 0.007184 * Height0.725 * Weight0.425 eGFRcr for this BSA = eGFRcr * BSA / 1.73
notes: eGFRcr is calculated by an equation developed by the Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration (CKD-EPI) and may be used to estimate kidney function when it is stable.[1]
To monitor and stage chronic kidney disease, eGFR normalized to a BSA of 1.73 m2 is used to allow for comparison of the patient's kidney function to normal values.

For medication-related decision making (dose adjustments), eGFR without normalization to BSA is used for patients with BSAs significantly lower or higher than 1.73 m2 (ie, small or very large patients).[2]

Confirmation of creatinine-based eGFR is appropriate for patients with high or low muscle mass (eg, amputations or muscle wasting), high- or low-animal-protein diets, or conditions or medications associated with changes in creatinine production or secretion.[2]
Calculators to estimate eGFR using the race-free CKD-EPI equations with creatinine and cystatin C combined (eGFRcr-cys) and cystatin C only (eGFRcys) are available separately.
Additional GFR estimation methods are discussed in the appropriate literature as well as UpToDate topics on the assessment of kidney function.

BSA: body surface area; eGFR: estimated glomerular filtration rate; eGFRcr: estimated glomerular filtration rate using creatinine; eGFRcr-cys: estimated glomerular filtration rate using creatinine and cystatin C combined; eGFRcys: estimated glomerular filtration rate using cystatin C; GFR: glomerular filtration rate.
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.

references.text: 1. Inker LA, Eneanya ND, Coresh J, et al; Chronic Kidney Disease Epidemiology Collaboration.
New creatinine- and cystatin C-based equations to estimate GFR without race. N Engl J Med. 2021;385(19):1737-1749. doi:10.1056/NEJMoa2102953[PubMed 34554658]

2. St Peter WL, Bzowyckyj AS, Anderson-Haag T, et al; National Kidney Foundation Workgroup for Implementation of Race-Free eGFR-Based Medication-Related Decisions. Moving forward from Cockcroft-Gault creatinine clearance to race-free estimated glomerular filtration rate to improve medication-related decision-making in adults across healthcare settings: a consensus of the National Kidney Foundation Workgroup for Implementation of Race-Free eGFR-Based Medication-Related Decisions. Am J Health Syst Pharm. 2025;82(12):644-659. doi:10.1093/ajhp/zxae317[PubMed 39552516]
3. Du Bois D, Du Bois EF. A formula to estimate the approximate surface area if height and weight be known. Arch Intern Med. 1916;17:863.
